name: hemorrhagic shock overview
title: Hemorrhagic shock: grade the loss from the vitals, where the pulse rises first and blood pressure holds through class II and falls only from class III, then treat in order: airway, breathing and circulation with help called, monitoring and bloods, two large-bore IVs and blood products up to a massive transfusion, stopping the cause, and throughout preventing the lethal triad of acidosis, hypothermia and coagulopathy

root.title: A bleeding woman: is she in SHOCK, and what do I do first?
lines: shock = tissue hypoxia; hemorrhagic: blood lost → ↓ preload → ↓ cardiac output
signs: tachycardia, hypotension, oliguria, confusion, tachypnea, cool clammy skin, acidosis, ↑ lactate

groups.title: How much has she lost? Grade it from the VITALS
lines: blood pressure is the LAST vital to move

groups.title: TREAT, in this order
lines: call for help before anything else
